title: Ruhaanika Dhawan Visits Divyanka Tripathi's Twin Boys in Heartfelt 'Full Circle' Reunion
excerpt: The Yeh Hai Mohabbatein actress who played Ruhi Bhalla shared photos with her on-screen mother's newborn twins, prompting an emotional exchange that has fans reliving the beloved show.
body:
Ruhaanika Dhawan, the child actress who became a household name as Ruhi Bhalla in Star Plus's long-running drama Yeh Hai Mohabbatein, has reunited with her on-screen mother Divyanka Tripathi — this time to meet Divyanka's real-life twin baby boys. The visit, documented in a series of social media posts, triggered an outpouring of nostalgia from fans and former co-stars alike.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=irKg-TS_uIw

A 'Full Circle' Moment

Ruhaanika, now preparing for her stint on Khatron Ke Khiladi Season 15, shared photographs of herself cradling the twins alongside Divyanka. In the caption, she described the reunion as deeply personal.

Divyanka, who has always spoken openly about the bond she shares with her young co-star, was quick to respond. Her comment on Ruhaanika's post — "You taught me how to be a mommy Ruh! Now these tiny ones have so much to learn from their Ruh dee" — struck a chord with fans who followed the pair's on-screen chemistry for years.

From Reel to Real

Yeh Hai Mohabbatein, which aired on Star Plus from 2013 to 2019, centred on the relationship between Divyanka's character Ishita Bhalla and Ruhaanika's Ruhi. The show was one of Indian television's highest-rated dramas, and the mother-daughter dynamic was widely credited as its emotional core.

"From playing her little one to holding my Ishima's little ones… life really has come full circle. I guess I can officially say she's blessed with three kids now. And the twins couldn't have asked for a cooler set of parents."

— Ruhaanika Dhawan, via Instagram

Off screen, the bond proved just as durable. At Divyanka's baby shower earlier this year, Ruhaanika had broken down in tears upon seeing her "Ishi Maa" expecting. "It felt like I was looking at my own mother step into motherhood," she told the Times of India at the time.

The latest reunion drew reactions from several former Yeh Hai Mohabbatein cast members, including Shireen Mirza, Krishna Mukherjee, and Aditi Bhatia, all of whom commented on Ruhaanika's post.

The Twins and a New Chapter

Divyanka Tripathi and Vivek Dahiya welcomed their twin boys on May 26, 2026, after announcing the pregnancy in March. The couple, who first met on the sets of Yeh Hai Mohabbatein — where Vivek played Inspector Abhishek Singh — married on July 8, 2016, and celebrate their tenth wedding anniversary this month.

When the twins arrived, the couple announced the news with characteristic warmth: "We asked for happiness… God said, 'Take double.'" They have since referred to the boys as T1 and T2, with Divyanka describing one as "calm like Shri Ram" and the other as "an attention magnet."

"Her comment on Ruhaanika's post — "You taught me how to be a mommy Ruh!"

What's Next for Both Actresses

Ruhaanika, now a teenager, is transitioning into a new phase of her career with Khatron Ke Khiladi Season 15, where she will take on physical challenges far removed from the family drama that made her famous. For Divyanka, the focus remains firmly on the twins, though her massive social media following — she remains one of Indian television's most-followed actresses — ensures that every parenting milestone reaches millions.

The reunion between the two underscores a reality that sets Indian television apart: the relationships formed on long-running shows often outlast the shows themselves. For the diaspora audience that grew up watching Yeh Hai Mohabbatein across time zones, Ruhaanika's visit is a reminder that some bonds remain unscripted.
